required_information: Ask for the deadline's date, time and timezone; an ambiguous deadline remains standard pending clarification, not automatically time-sensitive.
From 15 November 2026 a known deadline within 48 hours may justify a time-sensitive review label; that label does not guarantee a response deadline, accepted handoff or outcome.
prohibited_actions: Infer a precise deadline or label the dispute time-sensitive from the ambiguous phrase
Record a handoff or any other CRM change
Promise a review result, refund or cancellation

evaluation_criteria.stop_condition: End after the missing deadline details and provisional standard label are explained; caller declines a recorded handoff.
